**Growth** – “We expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter‑on‑quarter in the mobile and other EMS business as consumer demand strengthens.” (Q1 FY 27)

**Growth** – “We are expanding the capacities of camera module in subsidiary Q Tech from 70 million annually to 180 million to 190 million annually over the next 15 to 18 months.” (Q1 FY 27)

**Growth** – “The joint venture with Inventec Corporation is expected to get operational from Q4 of this fiscal.” (Q1 FY 27)

**Growth** – “We have started manufacturing semi‑automatic washing machine in the higher capacity categories… Addition of our new manufacturing facility in Tirupati will expand our capacities… including fully automatic front‑loading washing machine 9, which will be launched in Q3 of this fiscal.” (Q1 FY 27)

**Growth** – “We expect to start export deliveries to the largest retail chain in U.S. and Germany in Q2 and Q3 of this fiscal.” (Q1 FY 27)

**Growth** – “We have initiated mini LED production and will transition to an OEM model by Q2 of ’27, alongside launch of sound bar TV sets.” (Q1 FY 27)

**Margins** – “Operating margin for the quarter reflected temporary compression… As increased input costs were passed through increase in selling prices, percentage margins look optically lower, mostly in mobile and IT hardware business.” (Q1 FY 27)

**Margins** – “We remain confident to deliver sustainable long‑term value… operating margins from the next fiscal of ’27, ’28.” (Q1 FY 27)

**Capex** – No explicit capital expenditure figures or guidance were provided in the transcript.
